mlp.extrapolation: Linear interpolation through batch 1/8/32; the 8-to-32 slope extends to batch 64.

limitations: The underlying prefill/decode service model inherits all v40-v42 limitations and is not a live serving-engine measurement.
Safety factors multiply the same queued-prefill-service estimate. They do not add decode occupancy, future-arrival prediction, CPU overhead, or uncertainty distributions.
The sqrt prompt credit is a hand-designed fairness control. It is not derived from a tenant contract, utility function, or formal weighted-fair-queue objective.
Rejected requests leave immediately and are not retried or routed to another replica.
Prompt-class Jain metrics weight 512/2048/6144 prompt classes equally rather than by offered traffic.
model: The v42 hard-100ms prefill admission model with 1/2/4/8x structural safety margins and an 8x sqrt-prompt-credit fairness control.

validation.accounting: The v40 base asserts exact accepted prefill/decode tokens, exact causal pairs, finite completion only for accepted requests, max batch 64, and KV within budget. Every admitted request satisfies its safety-adjusted threshold and hard slices report zero budget violations.
